changes.text: 前线将领当面许下封赏，一位外国将领在旁作保，城门因此打开。等到对方上门要求兑现，这份承诺该算谁的？
A field commander promised rewards face to face, a foreign officer stood guarantor, and the city gates opened. When the other side came to collect, whose promise was it to keep?
同治二年十月，官军已经攻破苏州外郭，守将李秀成、谭绍洸退进内城死守。官军从水陆三面合围，城里粮食吃完了，人心开始动摇。守军中的下级将领郜云官等人，向城外的官军将领程学启通款，请求投降。

In the tenth month of the second year of the Tongzhi reign, government forces had broken through the outer walls of Suzhou. Two of the city's commanders, Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang, fell back into the inner city and held on. The besiegers closed in from three sides, by land and by water. Inside, the food ran out and the garrison's resolve began to waver. Gao Yunguan and other subordinate commanders among the defenders made overtures to Cheng Xueqi, a general on the government side outside the walls, offering to surrender.
郜云官乞降之后，程学启和戈登亲自乘小船到城北的阳澄湖，与郜云官等人当面订约。城外一方提出的条件是：杀掉李秀成、谭绍洸，把首级献上来；作为交换，许给二品的封赏。戈登是这份约定的保人。梁启超紧接着写了一句「戈登爲之保人，故云官等不疑」：因为有戈登作保，郜云官等人才没有疑心。按梁启超的写法，降将肯信这份约，靠的是戈登的担保。

After Gao Yunguan's offer reached him, Cheng Xueqi went with Gordon by small boat to Yangcheng Lake, north of the city, to settle terms face to face with Gao and his fellow commanders. The terms put to them were these: kill Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang and deliver their heads, and in return receive rewards of the second rank. Gordon acted as guarantor. Liang's next line, in translation, is that because Gordon stood as their guarantor, Gao Yunguan and the others had no doubts. As Liang tells it, what made the defectors trust the pact was Gordon's guarantee.
现在回到戈登。八人投降时，他正是阳澄湖降约的保人。梁启超写他「聞鴻章之食言也，大怒」：听说李鸿章不守诺言，戈登勃然大怒，想杀李鸿章抵罪，「自攜短銃以覓之」，亲自带着短枪去找李鸿章。「鴻章避之，不敢歸營」，李鸿章躲开了，不敢回营。几天后，戈登的怒气渐渐消了，这才作罢。

Now return to Gordon. When the eight surrendered, he had been the guarantor of the pact made on Yangcheng Lake. Liang writes, in effect, that when Gordon heard Li Hongzhang had broken his word, he was enraged. Gordon wanted to kill Li Hongzhang to make him pay, and went looking for him with a pistol himself. Li Hongzhang kept out of his way and dared not return to camp. After a few days Gordon's anger slowly cooled, and he let the matter drop.
这件事之后，常胜军仍与淮军一同作战：刘铭传、郭松林等人率部与常胜军共同进攻常州一带，攻克宜兴、荆溪，擒获敌将黄靖忠。

After this, the Ever-Victorious Army still fought alongside the Huai Army: Liu Mingchuan, Guo Songlin and other commanders led their troops with it against Changzhou and the surrounding area, taking Yixing and Jingxi and capturing the enemy commander Huang Jingzhong.

把这件事拆开看，降约里有三个角色。许诺的是程学启：湖上与降将订约的是他和戈登，许以总兵、副将等职的是他；作保的是戈登，书中明说降将「不疑」是因为他；决定不兑现的，是程学启与李鸿章的密谋。值得注意的是，主意出自程学启的判断，戈登去找的却是李鸿章，书里用的词也是「鴻章之食言」。一种解释是：在戈登看来，前线将领的许诺代表的是统帅；统帅点头杀降，就等于统帅本人食言。许诺可以由前线作出，兑现与否却要由上面来担。

Take the episode apart and the pact had three roles. Cheng Xueqi made the promise: he and Gordon settled terms with the defectors on the lake, and it was Cheng who promised them posts such as brigade general and deputy general. Gordon guaranteed it, and the book says plainly that the defectors had no doubts because of him. The decision not to pay came from the secret plan between Cheng and Li Hongzhang. Yet the idea grew out of Cheng's judgment, while the man Gordon went hunting for was Li Hongzhang, and the book's own phrase is that Hongzhang had broken his word. One reading is that, to Gordon, a field commander's promise spoke for his superior; once the superior agreed to kill men who had surrendered, the broken word was his. Promises may be made at the front, but whether they are kept is answered higher up.
第二层是保人的处境。书中写戈登是「聞」，本文据此推测，他是事后才听说这件事的。降将因为他才不起疑；降将被杀，他作保的那句话也跟着落空。

The second layer is the guarantor's position. The book says Gordon heard of it; this article infers from that word that he learned of it after the fact. The defectors had trusted the pact because of him; when they were killed, his word as guarantor fell with them.
第三层是程学启的理由。十几万部众、「聲勢洶洶」、「狼子野心」，书中给出的是一笔控制风险的账。
The third layer is Cheng Xueqi's reasoning. More than a hundred thousand troops, a menacing presence, men he judged wolf cubs at heart: what the book sets out is a calculation about controlling risk.
本文只依据梁启超《李鸿章传》一部书。这部书以李鸿章为中心，降将一方和戈登本人的说法都没有进入证据。许诺的内容有两种说法：湖上订约时是“二品之赏”，城破后降将要求兑现的是“总兵副将等职”，本文无法判断两者的关系。十几万部众、一千多余党等数字，都取自这部书，本文未与其他记载核对。

This article rests on a single book, Liang Qichao's biography of Li Hongzhang. The book centres on Li Hongzhang; neither the defectors' version nor Gordon's own account is among the evidence. The promise is also described in two ways: at the lake it was rewards of the second rank, while after the city fell the defectors asked for posts such as brigade general and deputy general. This article cannot determine how the two relate. The figures of more than a hundred thousand troops and more than a thousand followers killed are taken from this book and have not been checked against other records.
全文只依据梁启超《李鸿章传》一种记载，缺少降将一方和戈登本人的叙述；许诺内容的两种表述之间是什么关系不明，文中数字均取自这部书，未另行核对。

The whole article relies on a single account, Liang Qichao's biography of Li Hongzhang, and lacks any narrative from the defectors or from Gordon himself; how the two descriptions of the promise relate is unclear, and the figures cited are taken from this book and have not been checked elsewhere.

dispositions.rationale: 摘要的“当面许下官职”把湖上当面所许的“二品之赏”和后来的“总兵副将等职”合成了一种许诺。中文改为“当面许下封赏”，英文同步改为 promised rewards face to face。

evidence.quote: 與雲官等面訂降約，使殺秀成、紹洸以獻，許以二品之賞
程學啟既許以總兵副將等職

dispositions.rationale: 英文原写法暗示守城的只有这两人。现改为 Two of the city's commanders，与原文“秀成及譚紹洸等”和中文写法一致。中文未改动，按同步规则原样给出全文。

evidence.quote: 秀成及譚紹洸等引入內城

dispositions.rationale: 杀李秀成、谭绍洸是城外一方提出的要求，降将最后只答应斩谭绍洸。中文改为“城外一方提出的条件是”，英文改为 The terms put to them were these，与下一段的让步不再矛盾。

evidence.quote: 然卒不忍害秀成，乃許斬紹洸而別

dispositions.rationale: 中文“二品的官赏”改为“二品的封赏”，去掉证据中没有的“官”字。英文 rewards of the second rank 原本准确，保持不变。
问题清单指出 E20 按语未通过逐字核对，属于须剔除的内容，文本中也有可疑字。现删去“梁启超在按语中评论说”至段末的内容，中英同步，只保留 E15 所载戈登大怒、寻李鸿章、数日后作罢；ev 中同时移除 E20。
“没有离开”暗示当时有过离去的可能，证据不支持。中文改为“仍与淮军一同作战”，英文同步修改，只陈述此后共同作战。
删去依据 E20 的“梁启超自己也把这笔账记在李鸿章名下”一句，中英同步；ev 中移除 E20。前一句引用 E15 的“鴻章之食言”，已足以支撑后面的解释。
中文引语改用「」，并按原文逐字写作「鴻章之食言」。
英文去掉 no doubts 的引号，改为译述，避免读者误以为是原文英语引语。
删去依据 E20 的“欺戈登”末句，中英同步；ev 中移除 E20。
删去依据 E20 的苗沛霖、李世忠旧事和“小聪明、小手段”一句，段落停在“控制风险的账”，中英同步；ev 只保留 E14。

evidence.quote: 謂狼子野心，恐後不可制

dispositions.rationale: 原句断言这些数字在全部来源中只有一处出处。现改为只说明本文的范围：数字取自这部书，本文未与其他记载核对。中英同步。
去掉“只有这一个来源”这一对完整来源的断言，改为说明文中数字均取自这部书、未另行核对。中英同步。
